mission "es-optimizer: Late mid test fleet"
	invisible
	landing
	on offer
		conversation
			`The test fleet "Late mid test fleet" is waiting at the spaceport: 1 × Command Starling, 3 × KIV Warship, 2 × KIV Disabler, 4 × Beetle Disabler, 2 × KIV Picket (12 ships). Crew and salaries are yours from now on.`
			choice
				`	(Take the ships.)`
					goto take
				`	(Not now.)`
					defer
			label take
			action
				give ship "Command Starling (late mid test fleet)" "Command Starling 1"
				give ship "KIV Warship (late mid test fleet)" "KIV Warship 1"
				give ship "KIV Warship (late mid test fleet)" "KIV Warship 2"
				give ship "KIV Warship (late mid test fleet)" "KIV Warship 3"
